messages:
anya: Kicking off Orbiton customer's LoRA merge into staging for compatibility/quant checks. Plan: run int8 + int4 suites, tokenizer mapping, and a short behavioral mini-eval. ETA ~1h. ping @sasha for the eval bundle

sasha: Sending the mini-eval bundle now — 120 convs, 40 numeric/currency cases, 20 long-context threads. GCS: gs://redwood-evals/orbiton/mini-2026-03-23.tar.gz

anya: Thx. Running with dynamic batching + prefix cache enabled. Note: we switched invoice prompt template (ORD -> ORDER) in the adapter; might bump false negatives for a bit. Will post diffs once first pass finishes.

eval-bot: automated run queued: job-id=job_98765, pool=dedicated-staging. Logs: http://ci.internal/jobs/job_98765 (starting now)

kevin: Quick question — Orbiton uses custom vocab v2, right? Last week we saw token shifts when adapters changed tokenizer merges. Any pre-checks?

anya: Yep custom-v2. Doing a token-map check first. Running simple script to diff token ids and OOVs.

anya: Code to run token check:
```
python tools/token_map_check.py --base-model open-7b --adapter orbiton-lora --map-output /tmp/orbiton-tokenmap.json
```

anya: Token map diff: 12 tokens remapped, 3 OOVs. I'll patch a remap for those 3 and rerun the mini-eval before quantized runs.

matt: Please pin seed + exact model revisions in run metadata so we can reproduce later. Also add a temporary canary route to fallback to open-7b if top-1 accuracy drops >5% on money-related queries.

anya: Done. Run metadata: model=orbiton-lora@v1.2, base=open-7b@2026-03-10, seed=42. Canary policy added to staging routing config.

eval-bot: smoke results (first pass): p50 latency +8ms, token-loss +0.6%, numeric MAPE +2.2% on int4 snapshot, hallucination rate ~unchanged. Full report: http://ci.internal/reports/orbiton/job_98765/report.html

sasha: Numeric drift on int4 is concerning for billing/invoice flows. Can you paste the top failing examples so we can triage if it's template vs quantization?

anya: Top diffs (truncated):
Example 1 - prompt: "What's the invoice total?"
  base: "USD 1,234.56"
  orbiton-int4: "USD 1234.56"  (formatting normalization)
Example 2 - prompt: "Convert € to USD"
  base: "USD 110.00"
  orbiton-int4: "USD 11.00"  (decimal place error)
Example 3 - long context: currency mention in thread, base returned correct cumulative sum, orbiton-int4 missed last line and returned lower total

kevin: Example 2 looks like quant rounding in the arithmetic head — try int8 and a calibration pass (quant-mode=calibrated) before doing a fix in the adapter.

matt: If int8 fixes numeric drift, we can temporarily serve the int8 artifact for customers with sensitive flows while we debug int4 calibration. Add a rollout flag.

anya: Agreed — launching int8 + calibrated quant run next (ETA ~35m). Will attach diffs and the failing prompts once done.

sasha: Thanks — once you have the int8 report, please mark which examples are reproducing on base vs only on adapter so we can decide whether to change prompt templates or quantization. :thumbsup:

anya: Will do. updating thread when int8 done.
